title: Affine derived mate factorization for the identity tilde representative
statement: Let $R,A,B,D$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebra structures on $A,B$ and an $(A\otimes_R B)$-algebra structure on $D$. Set $E=A\otimes_R B$, $\alpha:E\to D$, $j:B\to E$, and let $\phi:A\to D$ and $\psi:B\to D$ be the two restrictions of $\alpha$. Assume the spectrum square with maps $f:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $g:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $p:\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, $f':\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ commutes. Assume the sheaf derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and module derived categories over $R,B$ exist. Let $M$ be an unbounded $A$-K-flat complex [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], let $K\in D_{QCoh}(\operatorname{Spec}A)$, and take $K=Q(\widetilde M)$ with $e$ its identity isomorphism. Assume the derived p-pullback counit on the homotopy object of $\widetilde M$ is invertible. Fix $i\in\mathbb Z$ and the fixed tensor model $m$ [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Let $C=D\otimes_A M$ formed with the restriction of $\alpha$ to $A$, and $C_g=D\otimes_{A,\phi}M$. Let $c_E$ be $m.comparison(i)$ followed by homology of $m.ordinaryToLocalized$ followed by the exact-restriction homology isomorphism. Let $\rho:\operatorname{res}_\psi\cong\operatorname{res}_j\operatorname{res}_\alpha$ be the identity-on-carriers scalar comparison. Put $s=\operatorname{res}_j(c_E)\circ\rho_{H^i(C)}^{-1}$ and let $z_0:H^i(C)\to H^i(C_g)$ be the equality transport from the specified restriction of $\alpha$ to $\phi$. Define $t:Q(\widetilde{C_g})\cong Lp^*K$ to be the inverse of the unit-normalized termwise tensor-pullback isomorphism, followed by the inverse derived pullback counit and $Lp^*e$ [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-coordinates; lem-weil-pbc-tilde-pullback-base-change]. With $T=\widetilde{(-)}$ on $B$-modules, $H=H^i$ on sheaves over $\operatorname{Spec}B$, and the explicit ordinary-to-derived pushforward map $q_{C_g}$ [lem-pc-affine-tilde-pushforward-cohomology-normalization], there is an isomorphism $e_C:T(\operatorname{res}_j(m.cohomology(i)))\cong H(Lg^*Rf_*K)$ such that $e_C\circ H(\beta_K)=T(s)\circ T(\operatorname{res}_\psi z_0)\circ q_{C_g}\circ H(Rf'_*t)$, in diagrammatic order, where $\beta$ is the pinned derived mate [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. This is a factorization through the ordinary pushforward complex; it asserts no natural target cohomology presentation. No quasi-coherence assumption on $Lp^*K$, cartesian assumption, or coefficient-map invertibility is required.

theorem exists_affineBaseChangeTildeMateIdentityFactorization
    (R A R' A' : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R'] [CommRing A']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] R') A']
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R')]
    (φg' : A →+* A') (φf' : R' →+* A')
    (hφg' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) = φg')
    (hφf' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = φf')
    (hw : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg') ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf') ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hM : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} A) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M)
    (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)))
    (hc : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)))) (i : ℤ)
 :
    let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let e := Iso.refl K
    let m := ModuleCat.baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A R' M A'
    let α := algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A'
    let j : R' →+* A ⊗[R] R' := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
    let T := tilde.functor (.of R')
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of R')).toRingedSpace)) i
    let C := (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (α.comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let Cg := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φg').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    let cE := m.comparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap m.ordinaryToLocalized i ≫
      ((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars α)).hom
    let ρ := ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp' j α φf' hφf'.symm
    let s := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).map cE ≫ ρ.inv.app (C.homology i)
    let z₀ := (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A') (.up ℤ) i).map
      (eqToHom (by dsimp only [C, α]; rw [hφg'] : C = Cg))
    let t := affineBaseChangeTildeRepresentativeIso A A' φg' K M e hc
    ∃ eC : T.obj ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).obj (m.cohomology i)) ≅
        H.obj ((derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))).obj
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))).obj K)),
      eC.hom ≫ H.map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf'))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) hw K) =
      T.map s ≫ T.map ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φf').map z₀) ≫
        affineTildePushforwardCohomologyMap A' R' φf' Cg i ≫
        H.map ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf'))).map t.hom)
